items.title: Kenny Gainwell: Has 304 yards in last three games
items.description:
Gainwell rushed five times for 16 yards and caught all three of his targets for 60 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

items.title: Baker Mayfield: Season-high 243 yards but two INTs
items.description:
Mayfield completed 18 of 32 passes for 243 yards, no touchdowns and two interceptions in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears. He also rushed once for no gain and ran in a two-point conversion.

items.description:
